pretreatments.description: Enzymatic Pretreatment: Mixed enzymes secreted by Trichoderma viride (ETv) and Aspergillus sp. (Ea) applied to maize straw (MS) powder in a 50 °C incubator for 6 days at varying ratios (ETv/Ea = 5/0, 4/1, 3/2, 2/3, 1/4, 0/5, 0/5).
Physical Pretreatment: Maize straw chopped into small pieces (5-8 cm) and ground using a FZ-102 Mini Plant Grinder before processing.
